evidence.finding: Only CLI, Runner, plugins, artifact SDK and official studio definitions are public here. Cloud and the web app are closed source.

evidence.title: WildCrane runner/README.md
evidence.locator: Platform, startup, recovery, folders and shared settings
evidence.finding: Current Runner documentation supports terminal operation on macOS, Windows and Linux and explicitly pauses desktop app support. Node 22 is required.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/README.md
evidence.finding: The former ai4kanban npm package is replaced by wildcrane; both expose akb. Task commands use Cloud IDs and authenticated API calls.

evidence.title: WildCrane docs/api/coverage.md
evidence.locator: Current UI gaps G01–G12 and protocol distinction
evidence.finding: First-party source audit describes Cloud/web APIs, but some referenced implementation paths are omitted from this public distribution.

evidence.title: WildCrane docs/api/task-review.md
evidence.finding: Documented Cloud review graphs freeze previews and invalidate affected downstream approvals when content or dependencies change. Closed server enforcement is not inspected.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/harnesses/index.ts
evidence.finding: Current coded adapters include Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Kimi, dsh, ZCode, Grok and Antigravity.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/providers.ts
evidence.finding: Per-harness provider declarations choose required settings and the runtime environment.

evidence.title: WildCrane runner/src/main.ts
evidence.locator: main sign-in, machine lock and lifecycle
evidence.finding: Runner requires a local Cloud session, signs in when absent, registers detected runtimes and owns the execution connection.

evidence.title: WildCrane runner/src/folders.ts
evidence.finding: Account-scoped local folder grants resolve real paths, reject system/home roots, and persist atomically. These select starting directories rather than an OS sandbox.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/commands/task.ts
evidence.finding: Task CRUD, comments, decisions, resume and stop operate on shared Cloud task identifiers.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/frontmatter.ts
evidence.finding: Markdown card metadata retains priority, status, blocked_by, related, modules, source references, preview approvals, questions and archive/restoration fields.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/start.ts
evidence.finding: Runs persist before a detached watcher starts. Sub-runs require a live parent, inherit its agent/runtime/folder and cannot create nested sub-runs.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/launch.ts
evidence.finding: Watchers run in detached process groups with logs and survive the initiating terminal closing.

evidence.title: WildCrane runner/src/connect.ts
evidence.locator: readJobs, startWorker and recovered job handling
evidence.finding: Runner reconciles claimed/interrupted jobs, preserves live flow workers and only starts jobs returned by the Cloud plan-limit admission service.

evidence.title: WildCrane runner/src/jobs.ts
evidence.locator: run job, checkpoint/recovery and result cost accumulation
evidence.finding: Checkpoints track model attempts, synchronization failures, run evidence and usage. Recovery distinguishes known outcomes from unsafe repetition.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/retry.ts
evidence.finding: The pinned code defines MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=4 with persisted attempts and bounded exponential backoff; this is newer than the README three-attempt description.

evidence.title: WildCrane runner/src/handoff.ts
evidence.finding: Recovery hashes task outputs and Git state and can create a separate copy directory under .akb/handoffs without replacing existing work.

evidence.title: WildCrane runner/src/task-folder.ts
evidence.finding: Current job startup requires an authorized linked project folder. Local board caches synchronize by sequence with conflict preservation and pinned artifact versions.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/memory.ts
evidence.locator: Project, module and agent memory paths
evidence.finding: Markdown memory separates project guidance, planner decisions/rejections/redesigns and studio/agent memory.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/roles.ts
evidence.finding: Built-in roles include discussion, memory pruning, conversation review and dismissal learning; role ownership is separate from CLI harness identity.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/complete.ts
evidence.finding: Completion validates the owning run and unchanged requirements, records commit/branch receipts and archives once. It accepts a reported Git outcome; it is not itself a merge or test runner.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/manual.ts
evidence.finding: The builder is instructed to manage its branch, worktree, checks and merge; a successful agent exit alone does not complete delivery.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/shared/delivery-evidence.ts
evidence.finding: Approved requirements retain title, opening request, scope and specialist sections while excluding mutable task bookkeeping.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/approve.ts
evidence.finding: Local approval rejects open questions and a running card owner before opening implementation.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/deliveries.ts
evidence.finding: Local delivery JSON retains sessions, requirements, outcome and repairable incomplete archives. These local records do not establish immutable organizational audit history.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/agent/own-cost.ts
evidence.finding: Claude cumulative session cost is reduced by the prior saved total to avoid charging earlier turns again; missing baselines stay unknown.

evidence.title: WildCrane runner/src/secrets.ts
evidence.finding: Runtime keys stay in mode-0600 secrets.json; registration reports key names present rather than key values.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/machine/telemetry.ts
evidence.finding: Usage reporting defaults on when unset. Opt-out clears queued events, sender state and install ID; unreadable settings disable reporting.

evidence.title: WildCrane cli/src/lib/telemetry-contract.ts
evidence.finding: Fixed telemetry fields include harness/model, estimated cost and board counters, with 90-day raw-event retention in the declared service contract.

changes.summary: Atomic revision 2 adds the OWN-03 telemetry off-switch question. Integration preparation checked the pinned CLI: reporting defaults on when unset, CLI events send without the app disclosure step, and akb telemetry off is a persistent product command that stops reporting. Other OWN-03 atomic answers are kept from agent:ADE-193-source; the claim awaits a new independent review.

before.telemetry_defaults: Reporting defaults on when unset; opt-out clears queued events, sender state and install ID. Unreadable settings disable reporting.

after.telemetry_defaults: On by default for the public CLI: usage reporting is on when the machine setting is unset, and CLI events are queued and sent without an interactive disclosure step; app events also wait for the disclosure step. This is vendor usage reporting, not model-provider task traffic. Unreadable settings disable reporting. Closed Cloud/web telemetry is not established from this source.
after.telemetry_off_switch: Run akb telemetry off: a dedicated, persistent CLI command that saves the machine setting and drops queued events, sender state and the install id. DO_NOT_TRACK also suppresses reporting. Closed Cloud/web controls and any current desktop settings page are not inferred from this command.
